speaker: Doctor
text: Is the pain localized to the inner (medial) side of your knee, specifically near the joint line? Does twisting your knee or stepping on uneven surfaces make the pain significantly worse?

speaker: Doctor

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: The MCL Stress Test shows no laxity or abnormal widening compared to the contralateral side, indicating an intact Medial Collateral Ligament.
